title: Mr Bean

schedules.description: Mr. Bean's bookcase collapses, so he buys a new one in the hardware store.
Mr. Bean is furious with the untidy state of the streets so he goes on a one-man mission to clean up the town.
Irma is coming for dinner, but Mr. Bean has forgotten about it and so doesn't have anything to cook.
Mr. Bean has to look after Mrs. Wicket's goldfish.
Mr. Bean takes Teddy on holiday to the seaside.
Mr Bean’s newspaper keeps getting stolen. Who is the cunning culprit?
Mr Bean is obsessed with his favourite TV show, Super Spy, but takes his snooping a little too far.
Mr Bean inadvertently becomes a teacher. Can he control the unruly class?
Mr Bean finally has a showdown with the mysterious Reliant Robin. Who will be the victor?
Mr. Bean has some unexpected guests who think he runs a hotel!
Mr Bean goes in search of wildlife, but he isn’t expecting to see anything prehistoric!
Mr Bean ends up on stage at the opera house... in a dress!
Mr Bean tries to get some muscles but attempts a shortcut to physical perfection.
Mr Bean is stuck in a lift and starts to annoy the other passengers.
Mr Bean is in a trance – barks like a dog and starts to dance.
Mr Bean is wracked with guilt after he chases Scrapper and ends up with a flattened cat.
Mr Bean takes trick or treating to the next level in a war with his next-door neighbours!
Mr Bean becomes an accidental wrestling champion – with a little help from two little old ladies.
Mr Bean finds himself babysitting a baboon.
Bean turns superhero in an attempt to outwit a cunning cat burglar.
Mr Bean’s buys a robot to clean his flat, but it ends up trashing half the town.
Mr Bean’s feeling down – everyone has forgotten his birthday and to make it worse Mrs Wicket is having a noisy party downstairs.
Mr Bean accidentally swaps trunks with a magician with magical results!
Mr. Bean’s pizzas are a huge success with everyone – well almost everyone.
Mr Bean needs to learn to dance to impress his girlfriend Irma.
Mr. Bean, obsessed with gaming, has to get his hands on the latest console.
Mr Bean dog sits for Irma and gets the idea for a new dog-walking business – how hard can it be?
Mr. Bean accidentally sends Irma a silly Birthday card and has stop it being delivered.
Mr. Bean discover that being bored is better than having to massage Mrs. Wicket.
Mr. Bean bets Irma that he can play the violin better than The Great Eduardo.
Mr. Bean has to retrieve a football from a haunted house … and get back out alive.
Scrapper gives Bean fleas, and Bean is forced to call in the pest control person.
Mr. Bean is determined to make the best cup of java, ever. Oh, and get rich brewing it…
Mr. Bean enters Scrapper into a beauty contest so that he can win First Prize: a trip with Irma to Paris.
Bean wants to avoid lunch with Irma’s Mum, at all costs.
Mr. Bean takes on the Bruisers at the local skateboard park, using only a mobility scooter!
Mrs. Wicket becomes annoyingly inconsolable when Scrapper goes missing.
Mrs. Wicket’s Nephew is staying with her when he wins two tickets to an Outward Bound course.
Mr Bean decides to stay in bed all day.
Mr Bean and Teddy go bowling.
Mr Bean wants to watch his favourite TV show with Billy, but Mrs Wicket has other plans.
Mr Bean becomes Mr Paliwal’s personal trainer for the day
Mr Bean is asked to wear a sheep costume to help advertise Irma’s knitwear stall.
At an amusement arcade, Teddy accidentally gets put in a claw machine as a prize!

Whilst out snapping nature with his camera, Mr Bean gets angry when
nature snaps back.
Mr Bean can't find a parking space. So he makes one of his own.

Mr Bean gets a real bug for painting. Then several bugs… and flies and
slugs and mice
The Battle of the Mimes.
His landlady smells a fish when Mr Bean gets a bird.
Mr Bean forgets his teddy’s Birthday - then gives him a treat to remember.
Mr Bean is driven to distraction by diabolical decibels.
A puzzling puzzle has Mr Bean truly puzzled.
Mr Bean discovers the great outdoors is not always so great.
During a visit to Buckingham Palace, Mr Bean meets the lady of the house.

Mr Bean, badgered by a strange pink animal, warms to the creature when it
shows its true colours.
Mr Bean makes it to the top of the ladder… and gets stuck.
Mr Bean has a bad hair day.
Mr Bean discovers being in hospital isn't always a bed of roses.
Mr Bean builds a supermarket super trolley.
Mr Bean is forced to look after his worst enemy.
Mr Bean nearly gets fed to the fish!
Mr Bean takes to the air after being taken for a ride.
Mr Bean tries his hand as an international art sleuth.

Romance is in the air and Bean's girlfriend is determined to have a piece of
it.

schedules.description: A group of soldiers attempting to rescue a hostage from a terrorist crash land into unfamiliar jungles which are inhabited by a group of long hidden dinosaurs. Now they must find a way out of this isolated valley before becoming prey for prehistoric predators.

In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, Female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & must work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures and mercenaries hired to finish them off. This battle's about to become primitive.

King Lear poses the question: What does it mean to be human? Its subtitle could be Being Human. Cruelty, barbarity, savagery, kindness, tenderness, love, in a world that gives not very much back. Set in the fictional present, an aging King invites disaster when he abdicates to his corrupt, toadying daughters, and rejects his loving and honest one.

From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.
While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

You can’t escape them. They’re everywhere. They bring tears to our eyes. They make us laugh. They bring us pain. Gordon a visionary inventor of the Rememory machine that allows him to see memories. He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.
Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

This is the true story behind the manhunt that brought America’s most fearsome boogeyman to justice. His name is Ted Bundy. A specter roams the highways of the gritty 1970s America hunting for his next prey. Tracking him are intrepid FBI female agent Kathleen & Robert Ressler organizers of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America’s most Notorious infamous serial killer.

With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable. After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

What makes a Good Boss? Is your boss good? Manipulative? Shamelessly meddles in his employees private lives? Crosses every line imaginable. The Good Boss is a biting character study with academy award winner Javier Bardem. To win the competition, the manipulative "good boss" unknowingly starts an explosive chain reaction with wild consequences.

John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

A Young couple thinking about buying their perfect single family starter home. They visits a real estate agency where they are received by a strange sales agent and find themselves trapped in a surreal, mysterious, maze-like nightmare.
Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

True Story that follows America’s most notorious Female Serial killer. Based on Aileen Wuorno’s early life. Back in 1976 a young Aileen arrives in Florida searching for a new life, marries a wealthy yacht club president to start as part of Florida’s high society. Tormented by her inner demons she surrenders to her murderous impulses havoc in the peaceful community.

Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer after making a shocking discovery of a woman being held captive. They must choose to run and hide, or face the killer whose dark secrets they have just exposed.

This timeless tale was originally written in 1757. Could Beauty ever love the ghastly lord, the Beast? The year is 1810. After losing his fortune at sea, a bankrupt merchant poor father-of-six, after plucking a scented rose from the repulsive master's garden must do the impossible, permit his daughter Beauty, to take his place and pay for the parent’s sins. Only true love can break the spell.

Surviving a fall from the sky, Chelios faces a Chinese mobster who has stolen his nearly indestructible heart and replaced it with a battery-powered ticker which requires regular jolts of electricity to keep working. He calls Doc Miles, an unlicensed cardiologist, who tells him there's only an hour's life in the artificial heart: keep it charged

A vacationing couple on an island off the coast of Thailand with no memory of the previous night must discover the mystery behind a strange video that shows one of them killing the other. In a web of mystery, black magic, and murder they must attempt to reconstruct the night's events & discover is she to blame for not being sacrificed or was it Mother Nature?

Joe Scott (Daniel Craig) is a washed up Hollywood star, whose hedonistic lifestyle of sex, drugs, and celebrity has taken its toll. Handsome even in his drug-addled 40s, he leads a directionless, lonely life in his opulent Malibu mansion. Only when confronted by tragedy is he forced to face up to the ghosts of his past.

From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

Every 23rd spring for 23days, it gets to eat…Stranded on a lonely road, a school bus full of high school players must defend themselves from the Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror - ancient beast that resurfaces on the earth every 23 years to feed.

schedules.description: India is heating up, as a wave of entrepreneurs are capitalizing on the growing demand for pleasure products, boosting the pleasure toy market to $112 million. Experts spill secrets, consumers share their intimate stories, and start-ups innovate new ways to derive pleasure. An insider look into an industry seldom talked about
Jonathan dives 100 feet deep to venture into deep & dark caves in the Bahamas.

schedules.programName: The Red Army Ep 01  The Great Patriotic War
schedules.description: Founded by Trotsky in 1918 amid total war, the Red Army abandoned its democratic ideals to crush civil uprisings. Fearing its power, Stalin launched the Great Terror of 1937-38, purging its officers. Weakened, the army nearly collapsed when Germany invaded in 1941. Only Zhukov's leadership, fierce resistance, and Allied support carried it to Berlin, uncovering death camps along the way.

schedules.programName: Children Of Jihadists The Impossible Return
schedules.description: Hundreds Of Children Of Jihadists Are Languishing In The De-Radicalization Centers In Syrian Kurdistan. Ageing From 11 To 21, These Children Have Witnessed First-Hand, The Horrors Committed By The Isis Fighters, At Times Even Coerced Into Picking Up Guns At A Young Age. Should These Children Be Held Responsible For The Fanaticism Of Their Parents, Or Do They Deserve A Second Chance In Life?

In 2018, an audacious heist shook Hyderabad as thieves broke into the iconic Nizam Museum and stole a priceless royal artifact. Valued in crores, this was not just a treasure but a piece of India’s cultural heritage. What sparked the heist, and how did relentless police work to solve a rare museum theft? A gripping journey into the culprits' minds and the high-stakes race to recover history

When was the Bible written? Who wrote it? For what purpose? These questions have long remained unanswered. With the discovery of the Dead Sea Scrolls, the thorough study of the texts, advances in science & recent archaeological discoveries, one of the greatest historical mysteries is being unveiled. Unearth new information & find answer to the fundamental question: who wrote the Bible?

schedules.programName: The Red Army Ep 02  The Cold War
schedules.description: Despite its wartime triumph, the Red Army fell from grace. Khrushchev revived it during the Cold War, but purely to crush uprisings by force, even as Soviet science raced ahead with nuclear weapons and the space program. After the Cuban Missile Crisis, it fought proxy wars around the world. By the 1970s, soldiers' lives grew harder, and the long war in Afghanistan helped break the Soviet system. When the USSR collapsed in 1991, the army became a symbol of memory and pride.

The Iran Hostage Crisis - For 444 Days, America Held Its Breath. Iranian Islamists Stormed The U.S. Embassy In Tehran, Seizing Diplomats And Humiliating The World'S Most Powerful Nation. What Began On November 4, 1979 Was More Than A Hostage Crisis. It Was The Moment A Former Ally Became America'S Most Dangerous Enemy, Changing The Course Of History Forever.

The Terror Attack Of October 7, 2023 By Hamas Has Plunged Israel Into A State Of Polarising Uncertainty. Citizens Are Divided In Their Ideologies, Where Some Continue To Support Netanyahu’S War In Gaza While Others In The Capital City Of Tel Aviv Are Hoping There May Be A Peaceful Way To End The Hostage Crisis. To What Extent Can The Ideological Divide Affect Israel & The Rest Of The World?

America's Colorado river is dangerously depleting, but are lawmakers, corporates & even farmers taking steps in conservating it? Using the issue of the river, this documentary showcases how corporate greed & politics ignore Climate Change despite events depicting its dawn on the planet. This film for brings to the fore eye-opening truths & innovative solutions
Are Screens Rewiring Our Minds? This Documentary Uncovers The Truth Behind Our Growing Screen Obsession And Its Effects On Our Daily Lives.

schedules.programName: Lebanon The Heist Of The Country
schedules.description: As Lebanon Collapses Under Corruption And Crisis, Its People Fight For Survival Against Leaders Clinging To Power And Wealth.

schedules.programName: To Achieve Happiness Health Wealth And Happiness
schedules.description: Journeying from Singapore, we uncover evidence-based strategies to rediscover happiness across key facets of life post-pandemic - from wealth and work to rest and health. Through intimate personal stories and encounters with experts and everyday heroes worldwide who overcame adversity, we distill a blueprint for well-being applicable to all
From Mumbai'S Slums To Global Fashion, Maleesha Kharwa'S Inspiring Journey Proves That Dreams Can Rise Above Any Circumstance.
A Fearless Rapper From Mumbai'S Govandi Defies Stereotypes, Using Hip-Hop To Challenge Prejudice And Inspire A New Generation.

Thanks To The Internet Which Helped Spread Stand Up Comedy Internationally, This Popular Form Of Humor Has Become The Lens Through Which Contemporary Issues Are Seen: In The Abundance Of Identities, A Global Movement Challenges The Established Order. Stand Up Told By Its Icons: Jamel Debbouze, Blanche Gardin, Ali Wong, Vir Das, Fary And Hannah Gasby.

schedules.programName: Inside Our Gardens By The Bay
schedules.description: Ten years on, Gardens by the Bay stands tall as an iconic Singapore attraction. Go behind the scenes to witness the teamwork and efforts required to keep this horticultural masterpiece on reclaimed inner-city land flourishing. From nurturing diverse flora to upkeeping the famed Super tree structures.

schedules.programName: Jean Paul Gaultier By Olivier Rousteing Diferent Generation Same Spirit
schedules.description: When Jean Paul Gaultier Stepped Back From His Own Runway, He Began Entrusting His House'S Haute Couture Seasons To A New Guest Designer Each July. This Documentary Follows Olivier Rousteing Of Balmain As He Steps Into That Legacy, From First Sketch To Final Bow. Go Behind The Scenes Of The 2022 Haute Couture Collection To See Two Designers, A Generation Apart, United By The Same Flamboyant, Boundary-Pushing Spirit Of French Fashion.
Scaling Burj Khalifa’s height, and cheetah’s speed, with sky-high luxury prices

schedules.programName: Expelled From The Top A Story Of Tibetan Refugees
schedules.description: They were left without homes & caught between worlds. Tibetan's heartbreak is far from over. After 70 years, Tibetan refugees still struggle to find justice and resolution. Sonam Choeden, a Tibetan refugee & a devoted mother separated from her three children, goes on her emotional journey back to India to meet His Holiness the Dalai Lama

Australia’s iconic Murray-Darling River is disastrously running dry amid corruption. Unleashing continental chaos captured by outraged locals, sparking a grassroots crusade to save the evaporating 30-million-year-old wonder from humanity-inflicted ecological ruin. Spotlighting Australia’s worst environmental disaster globally, probing corrupt water schemes prioritizing profits over people

schedules.programName: Pause With Purpose Serving Of Other First
schedules.description: Burnt Out By Her Daily Life, Jacinda, A 36-Year-Old Chef, Volunteers At A Soup Kitchen In The Philippines. Over Her Three-Week Stint, She Faces A Reality That Challenges Her Beliefs About Her Purpose. Will She Return Home With Her Passion Restored Or Change The Course Of Her Life Altogether?

Edwin Is Ready To Turn His Dream Of Living Abroad Into A Reality. After His First Visit To Japan, He Purchases An Akiya, An Abandoned House In The Countryside. For A Year, The Diy Enthusiast Renovates The Property Alone In Hopes Of Starting A New Business, And A New Life, In A Town Near Mount Fuji.

schedules.programName: Pause With Purpose Drawing On Strength
schedules.description: After Family Losses And The End Of A Long-Term Relationship, The 28-Year-Old Isabella Travels To A Country She Has Never Visited. For Two Weeks, She Joins A Work Exchange In Nepal, Farming And Living With A Local Host Family. As She Forges New Connections, She Must Also Confront The Struggles She Left Behind At Home
Against The Odds Of Age And Tradition, Four Indian Seniors Seek Connection, Companionship And A Second Chance At Love.

In 2010, BP's Deepwater Horizon oil rig exploded killing 11 men. Over 200 million gallons of oil poured into the sea for 3 months impacting an area the size of England and Scotland combined. The first oil spills washed ashore on Grand Isle, Louisiana. Years later, while the authorities and the US government claim that the shore is completely safe, locals assert that they are still facing the effects of the world’s biggest oil spill. This feature documents the impact the spill had on Grand Isle’s health, economy and businesses, and how it continues to haunt them.

Emmy Award-winning cameraman, Gavin Newman, delves into the discovery in Borneo of the Sarawak Chamber, the largest unsupported structure on Earth. A group of cavers who found the place in 1978, revisit it three decades later and realize that it not only still exists but is also growing. Till date, the caves have been largely unexplored though accompanied visits can be arranged by the Gunung Mulu National Park. This feature uses cutting-edge techniques and technology to tell the story of one of the world’s most ancient places.

In 2016, the 'Thane Call Centre Scam' shocked everyone in the BPO industry. Scamsters from India impersonated IRS officials, swindling $50 million from Americans, especially targeting senior citizens, by instilling fear, and funneled the money back to India. The documentary exposes the modus operandi of these call center crimes as they continue to proliferate

A gripping investigation into how Russia's intervention in Syria became the blueprint for its war in Ukraine. Featuring rare archives and expert insights, the film reveals how a forgotten conflict reshaped global geopolitics and modern warfare.

The couturier who saved Paris fashion with the legendary 'New Look' revolutionized haute couture in post-war France. Christian Dior established his fashion house and debuted groundbreaking feminine designs, departing from dull wartime simplicity. Although he passed away in 1957, the House of Dior evolved his visionary style, sparking new fashion eras even today

schedules.programName: Gateway Of Europe The Migrant Crisis
schedules.description: Gateway of Europe – Lampedusa, a small Italian island – is today overrun by illegal migrants, who risk their lives in hope of a better future. As the town grapples with this human crisis, it has become a battleground of hope and fear, unity and division—mirroring the European continent's deep struggle with identity, values, and its response to a changing world

schedules.programName: 12 Digit Masterstroke The Untold Story Of Aadhaar
schedules.description: An unlikely team of public & private sector professionals spearheaded by tech wizard Nandan Nilekani came together to create one of the world's largest social identity program. They defied all odds & crafted a unique identity for 1.4 billion Indians. Narrated by Ankur Warikoo, the story captures the journey of Aadhaar Card from inception, to its implementation across different governments
Putin Is Redrawing Russia’S Global Influence. Explore The Strategy, Alliances And Ambitions Driving Moscow’S Return As A Major World Power.

Four young millionaires decode the 2024 kid economy and the kid influencer ecosystem, navigating the challenges of trolls, backlash, and the fading notion of a traditional childhood with the tag of Generation Alpha super kids who balance fame with growing up. Through the eyes of their families, experts, and filmmakers, we explore if their glamorous lives are worth the trade-offs

The remarkable journey of ASEAN's unsung heroes, fighting tirelessly against illegal fishing, rescuing street dogs, and championing sustainable agriculture. We unveil a side of the region rarely seen, delving into issues close to the hearts of its people. Witness the rich tapestry of Southeast Asia through the stories and lives of those dedicated to preserving nature

schedules.programName: The Price Of War Ukraines Lost Youth
schedules.description: For The Past Three Years, Ukraine'S Youth Have Been Growing Up In A Warzone. As The Fighting Intensifies, The Number Of Victims Is Increasing. The Lives Of Millions Of Young Ukrainians, Like Napoléon, Plombir, Timur And Hannah, Have Been Irrevocably Changed.

Witold Pilecki Didn't Escape Auschwitz, He Chose To Enter It. This Polish Resistance Fighter, Deliberately Walked Into The Nazi Death Camp, Spending Nearly 1,000 Days In Humanity'S Darkest Nightmare. From Inside The Horror, He Built A Secret Network, Planned A Daring Uprising And Smuggled The Truth About The Holocaust To The Outside World. This Is History'S Most Unbelievable True Story.

A Select Group Of Skilled Professionals Routinely Work With Dangerous Sharks As They Study, Photograph, And Interact With Them. The Fish Range From The Massive Cold-Water Sharks In Canada To Great Whites In Mexico And South Africa, And The Tiger Sharks In The Bahamas. While The Whale Shark Attracts A Devoted Following And You Can Now Scuba-Dive With Them In Aquariums, Is The Popularity Of The Activity Endangering The Same Sharks?

schedules.programName: Black Thursday In The Black The Pan El Saga
schedules.description: Singapore, 1985: As Glenn Knight Leads The Newly Formed Commercial Affairs Investigation Department (Caid), Housewife May Pours Her Savings Into Pan-Electric Industries. Journalist Conrad Raj Uncovers Troubling Signs As The Company'S Mounting Debt Threatens The Stock Market. When The Singapore Stock Exchange Shuts Down For Three Days, A Financial Crisis Erupts And The Hunt For The Culprits Begins.

Human rights activist Muhammad Rabbani's refusal to surrender his phone password ignites an investigation into Phantom Parrot, a covert British surveillance program targeting minorities. As explosive documents emerge, the film reveals the dark intersection of technology, surveillance, and structural racism, critiquing the dangerous power of data.

Commemorating the seventieth anniversary of Anne Frank’s death, this documentary goes back in time, reliving Anne’s story with inputs from her stepsister, Eva Schloss. Her father, Otto Frank, who found her diary, was instrumental in ensuring that his late daughter’s writings weren’t swept under the carpet. The earnestness with she describes the Holocaust, her experience living through it, were key reasons for the popularity of the diary on publication. But were there other factors that made this teenager a legend? Discover the myriad reasons for her enduring appeal in this feature

schedules.programName: Epic Trails Banff And Lake Louisein Summer
schedules.description: Witness The Vibrant Beauty Of Mountains & The Blue Lakes Of Canada’S Oldest National Park.
Take A Hike To Northern Australia’S Wondrous Mountains & Witness Breathtaking Views.

We Discover The Many Splendors Of A Fragile World Of Bees - From Nighttime Gathering, Moving Of The Hives To Mountain Pastures And In Science Laboratories. It’S A Story Of Love, Sometimes Dangerous, Between Bees And Men, That Teaches Us To Preserve Nature’S Capacity For Renewal And To Respect The Cultural Practices Of Human Beings.
The heroic story of a Jewish American Army personnel who secretly & successfully escaped from Nazi-occupied Germany during the World War II

schedules.programName: The Social Trap 5 Women Vs The Big 5
schedules.description: The Social Trap: 5 Women Vs The Big 5 (2025) Is A Documentary Directed By Elisa Jadot Exploring The Dangerous, Largely Unregulated Impact Of Social Media On Children. Following Five Women From The Us And Europe, It Highlights Their Fight Against Tech Giants Like Meta, Tiktok, And Snapchat, Focusing On Issues Like Addiction, Mental Health, And Exploitation.

Often Used As An Insult To Describe Poor, Uneducated, Rural Americans, The Term ""Redneck"" Is Being Embraced By A New Generation Who Are Viscerally Proud Of Their Country And Its Traditions.

On Friday, 13Th November 2015, Journalist Daniel Psenny Filmed From His Apartment Window, The Terrified Survivors Who Were Fleeing The Terrorist Attack That Took Place At The Bataclan Concert Hall In Paris. Ten Years Later, He Reconnects With Those Caught In His Images, Exploring The Memories Of That Horrifying Massacre That Killed 132 People.
Explore Remote Villages, Ancient Customs & Dramatic Views Of The Abundant Islands Of Fiji.

LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.

This is the true story behind the manhunt that brought America’s most fearsome boogeyman to justice. His name is Ted Bundy. A specter roams the highways of the gritty 1970s America hunting for his next prey. Tracking him are intrepid FBI female agent Kathleen & Robert Ressler organizers of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America’s most Notorious infamous serial killer.

Set in the fictional present, an aging King invites disaster when he abdicates to his corrupt, toadying daughters, and rejects his loving and honest one.

What makes a Good Boss? Is your boss good? Manipulative? Shamelessly meddles in his employees private lives? Crosses every line imaginable. The Good Boss is a biting character study with academy award winner Javier Bardem. To win the competition, the manipulative "good boss" unknowingly starts an explosive chain reaction with wild consequences.

A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

Terrorists kidnap the Russian Prime Minister's two kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant and threaten to blow up a reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in but are no match to a Next Generation UniSol. The world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

Fahad a mentally fragile man racing against time must risk everything he holds dear, including his principles and the fragile sanity he clings to.

The creature that emerges becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare. What has she been hatching under everyone's noses that shocks them all?

Based on the international best-selling novel The Room. Corner Office an absurdist tale of a man lost in his own space. Our corporate hero is trying to move up in his newly acquired job and discovers a secret room in his office building; his alienation deepens when he discovers a room he's told doesn't exist. Discover human behavior to find humor in the absurdity of everyday life.

As she explores the wild cliffs and windswept beaches nearby, she uncovers what really happened with the help of Vatican priest, not only the murder but a disturbing truth about her own past which brings long-buried trauma to the surface.

title: Journy

schedules.description: Scott and Justin catch up with their high school friend Fran, who is travelling to Vietnam to explore his motherland and family history for the first time. They travel south to north, through the commotion of Ho Chi Minh City and the Mekong River floating markets, and experiencing haunting remnants of the Vietnam war and visiting magical and mysterious temples and caves along the way. Further north, surrounded by the beauty of Halong Bay, the guys realize that spending time with Fran’s family, and seeing the country through his eyes, has given them a fresh perspective on travel.

One of the most fascinating places on earth, and one of the most dangerous, Papua New Guinea is a rough and mostly unexplored country. The guys meet up with their friend Nick on the island of East New Britain, where they visit the lava-buried city of Rabaul, and climb up, and into, an active volcano. Next they explore the island and local dive sites for abandoned World War II relics. Making their way through some thick jungle, they spend a night in a remote family village on their way to a spectacular fire-dancing tribe.

schedules.programName: On The Record With Mick Rock
schedules.description: Mick discovers how the Grammy Award-winning rock stars, Kings of Leon, escaped their Pentecostal roots to find a home in Nashville’s evolving music scene. The band dishes on its rocky past and gives Mick a tour of country music’s hometown, ending the day in the Kings’ private studio for an exclusive jam session.
Eric Hanson explores some of Montana's best trails and landscapes in Kootenai National Forest.
Eric Hanson seeks adventure on the Maah Daah Hey Trail in Theodore Roosevelt National Park.

One of the most fascinating places on earth, and one of the most dangerous, Papua New Guinea is a rough and mostly unexplored country. The guys meet up with their friend Nick on the island of East New Britain, where they visit the lava-buried city of Rabaul, and climb up, and into, an active volcano. Next they explore the island and local dive sites for abandoned World War II relics. Making their way through some thick jungle, they spend a night in a remote family village on their way to a spectacular fire-dancing tribe.

theme.name: International
theme.shortDescription: Thoughtfully chosen content from around the world that will get you hooked to your screen!
theme.description: Thoughtfully chosen content from around the world that will get you hooked to your screen!

description: JOURNY is a free travel and lifestyle FAST channel that inspires curiosity through meaningful storytelling. Discover breathtaking destinations, diverse cultures, and authentic experiences from around the world, with documentaries and travel films that encourage exploration and a fresh perspective on the world.

title: Pocket Films

schedules.description: In this heartfelt story, a mother calls out to her daughter, only to be scolded by her husband. Her daughter, Meera, is a special child who cannot speak or hear, yet her mother sends her to school with hope. Despite the chaos and negativity around her, Meera remains blissfully unaware, finding beauty and positivity in everything. Her innocence and zest for life serve as a touching reminder of the purity within, even in a world filled with harsh words.

A director is accused by an upcoming actress of harassing her and asking her to sleep with him and he would cast her in his next film, these allegations literally destroy his career, but are all allegations always true?

Kundli - is a film about values in life, which change some decisions against the will of the characters. It's about two meetings of these characters in a different time period and shows the changes that have occurred in their lives. Though along with time things have changed but there are something’s which are unforgettable at the back of the mind. Kundli is a film about small things that have remained though the times have changed.

Chhavi belongs to a Brahmin family. She loves Aakash who is from a backward caste. Chhavi’s father is very disappointed with her daughter’s decision. Her father orders local inspector Dubey to catch Aakash to rough him up. But Chhavi’s elder brother Vicky appears in between. Vicky’s intention seems as he will blow Aakash’s head off. But there is a twist in the tale.

Payal and Nikhil have been married for 14 years, have lived happily and celebrated all the important occasions together. But now, sitting at the breakfast table, Nikhil breaks his silence, tells Payal that he does not want to drag this relation any further since there is no love left in their relationship. He confesses that he is in love with his colleague and they should get a divorce. Payal tells him that she will give him divorce but she has conditions which need to be fulfilled. Will Nikhil agree to it? What is the condition? Watch this awesome romantic short film to find out.
All the fears of a girl come to life after she travels in a late-night taxi she had booked. Does she reach home safely?
Life 2.0 is the reflection of modern life, where Humans have become like God. GOD means generator, operator & destroyer but look at us, what are we doing; we are also doing the same.

Joy and Ichcha elope from their respective houses as their parents are against them getting married. They take shelter at Joy's friend, Mihir's place. Mihir, who meets Ichcha for the first time is enchanted with her beauty. He is wondering why the families are against such a wonderful pair. Watch to find out the secret behind.

Bahaar is a haunting tale of a young bride crushed under the weight of infertility and expectations. Once cherished, she’s slowly erased—until the family finds a “solution.” A heart breaking reflection on womanhood, shame, and broken promises.
Two girls accidentally find out that in addition to the man they unknowingly share, they also share a lot of gifts from him. Including a game of Ludo which resembles their lives in some manner.
In a tale of wealth and solitude, two orphaned brothers lead opulent yet lonely lives, marked by the younger sibling's constant neglect by the elder.

Confronting terminal lung cancer, a resolute mother sets out on a heartfelt journey to prepare her bright 7-year-old son with the emotional strength to cope with her impending absence, treasuring their remaining time together.
A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

Rajeev is afflicted by an unusual illness, confounding even his doctor, who's encountering such a case for the first time. Is it a supernatural phenomenon or something within the confines of their home? Unravel the mystery in this quirky 14-minute narrative.

Inspector Maya Verma Has Just Arrested A Young Girl From The Red Light District. Kanchan Is Defiant And Unaffected, At First. A Conversation Between Them Leads To An Interesting Revelation. A Twisted Night With A Twisted End.

Everyday violence in the household plagues the childhood of a girl. The helplessness and anxiety that arises from such an experience builds in her as she grows up. Her aversion to authority manifests itself in extreme outcomes later.
A senior woman grapples with dementia, compelling her husband to confront challenging choices.

A couple who is head over heels in love with each other with a love that's extraordinary yet relatable. The wife is told by everyone that she is too trusting of her husband. The wife makes a pact with her husband that if she ever acts like an ordinary suspecting wife he can change her name. The universe then puts her to the test on their wedding anniversary. The husband then makes her admit her true feelings as a wife and believe that possessiveness and jealousy in moderation are good.

After a 15-year absence, Vikrant comes back home, only to be unexpectedly entangled in a web of unresolved issues and unspoken tensions with his mother. Confronting painful truths and reopening old wounds, he embarks on a quest for answers that could mend the fractured bonds between them. In this emotionally charged narrative, Vikrant must face his past to forge a brighter future and repair the ties strained by time.

The man is displaying the behaviour of a thug. He receives calls similar to those of Abbas Khan. Along his journey, he follows a couple in their mid-twenties. Initially, they appear in Christian attire, then in Gujarati attire. Later, they appear in Muslim attire. one day the thug catches both of them. And he confronts them in front of Abbas Khan. At that time, there was a confrontation between the thug and Abbas Khan regarding money. At that time, the real story was revealed.

Danish, a village boy with kabaddi dreams, faces adversity as he's unfairly removed from his team due to a dispute he didn't start. Despite family discord, his father stands by him. A new opportunity arises, showcasing Danish's talent. He's selected for the biggest game of his life, but tragedy strikes: his father passes away. Will Danish find the strength to play on, honoring his father's memory?
Based on true events, this poignant tale follows a young boy navigating life after losing his father and the unwavering efforts of his single mother to raise him against all odds.

A newlywed longs to drive her dowry car, but is stalled by her husband's ego and her mother-in-law’s control. The Driver’s Seat is a quiet rebellion about agency, freedom, and the fight to take control—on the road and in life.

A gym freak eagerly awaits his cheat day, but family drama and an empty wallet stand in his way. As he navigates the chaos of Mumbai, will he find a way to satisfy his cravings, or will the city serve up an even bigger surprise? A fun-filled ride of food, family, and unexpected twists!

Laxmi works as a maid at the house of a couple. She reaches home early only to find the owners of the house dead. She panics and tells her boyfriend about this. He thinks of a plan and tells her to rob the jewelry and cash from the house. Will she be able to do it? or is she falling for a trap?

Saurabh gets a match on a dating app and enlists his friend Shobhit’s help. But when Shobhit steals the spotlight—and the girl—things take a hilarious turn. Lies unravel, friendships are tested, and just when you think it's over… another match changes everything! A fun-filled tale of love, loyalty, and second chances

Mihika, a 22 year old, fights with her dad yet again over going out late at night. She finds it very unreasonable of him to be so worried now that she’s 22. Waiting for her cab, she overhears her building’s supervisor talking on a phone call with his own daughter. She steps in and debates with him about how he shouldn’t be upset about her being out late at night but understands his perspective too in the process. She then goes back home to apologise and reconcile with her dad. The supervisor also understands his daughter’s situation better through this chance encounter.

Amir, who is in his mid-20s, is struggling with self-doubt and feeling trapped in his work routine. Unfortunately, his habit of being consistently late has caused him to fall out of favor with many people, including himself. This has created a vicious cycle that he has been unable to break free from despite his best efforts. However, having a supportive inner voice has been a great blessing for him as he tries to push through his struggles.
Love has many things hidden instore. What happens and Why does it happen? The secrets will be revealed in Kidnapped

The husband and wife both suffer from dementia, but with the help of a compassionate doctor and nurse, they make an effort to recover. Unfortunately, their attempts are unsuccessful, but their daughter finds solace in visualizing her parents as alive through virtual reality

Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

After a dinner-time discussion about mental health turns sour, Kamlesh (55) riles his daughter, Disha, a clinical psychologist, into storming off from the gathering. This incites Kamlesh into visiting three doors to his past that make him realise that he himself suffers from a mental health disorder. 'Kshan' is a recollection of a broken man's traumatic events and his realisation that drives him to seek help from his daughter after learning to let go of his ego.

One evening a couple, Kishan and Aparna reach home to witness what they have feared the most. This compels them to take the most critical decision of their life. Will they be able to live with the practical decision they make?

L’Idiot tells the story of Rinku, a young, eccentric man who is captivated by French culture and hopelessly infatuated with Mona, a charismatic and free-spirited girl in his language class. His romantic fantasies and attempts to impress Mona take a comedic yet dark twist when he encounters a mysterious “thief,” who manipulates Rinku into a dubious scheme to win Mona’s affection. Rinku’s innocent longing for friendship and love leads him into an awkward and ultimately dangerous pursuit.

Javed already married but still he wants second marriage. His first wife Rukhsar opposed him, he beats her and second day he gets his second wife Afsana at home. Because of jealousy, bitterness revenge game starts between both wives.
A shy office worker’s silent crush blossoms inside an elevator, where missed chances and quiet longing test his courage to finally speak.

Raah is an exploration of the several stages of struggle when one steps out to pursue a dream. Sahir lives in Mumbai city with his family. The emotional and poetic narrative explores his faith, kinship and his struggle to establish himself as a poet/writer.

After the death of a loved one, young Yatin takes on the responsibility of caring for his ailing mother-in-law. As he prioritizes her well-being, he faces numerous hardships, intertwining their lives unexpectedly.

Arjun is a soldier who works more like a mercenary in a never-ending war. He willfully follows the brutal orders of his commanding officer until one day, his entire world turns upside down. Examining one soldier's journey toward redemption, we show that our shared humanity is always worth fighting for underneath the trappings of all that divides us.

After losing his fiancée, Vishu is drowning in grief, unable to see a way forward. On the verge of giving up, a mysterious encounter changes everything, offering him a new perspective on life. Will he embrace the second chance fate has given him?

Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

A single mother, living in a small village, takes care of her little daughter’s educational expenses by doing tailoring work. One day, she receives a pension letter, for which she has to visit the Gramin bank. There, she encounters something unexpected.

Story of a young married actress struggling with societal pressure over her fashion choices. Her husband's disapproval leads to arguments and a dilemma regarding societal acceptance. Ultimately, an unexpected accident brings resolution. Watch to explore how the protagonist navigates through societal expectations and challenges in her personal life.

Sajan Tiwari', in his mid 30s, works as a small time estate agent in Lucknow. He is involved in an extra-marital affair. His only son, 5 year old 'Bunty', catches him in the act. Scared out of his wits, 'Sajan' makes every possible effort to stop 'Bunty' breaking the news to his wife 'Manju'. The story is a humorous take on small town life, relationships and family.

A doctor encounters a couple suffering from Dementia, and attempts to alleviate their condition. Upon receiving a call from the couple's son who lives in America, the doctor visits their home and is shocked to find the couple arguing and displaying symptoms of Dementia. The doctor diagnoses the woman with Lewy bodies Dementia, which causes visual hallucinations.
How a delivery guy gets entangled in a game orchestrated by a mysterious woman, leaving him questioning her true intentions.

On a fateful day, Parul hails a taxi to visit her boyfriend Ansh. Ansh, eagerly anticipating her arrival, is thrown into restlessness. However, their journey takes an unexpected turn when the taxi driver receives news of his daughter falling ill. Witnessing this, Parul's compassionate response sparks anger in Ansh. Yet, in the face of adversity, Parul's decision unfolds, offering inspiration to the youth. This is the tale of "On the Spot."

Ria, a rising model, and Juhi, a top creative director, share an unbreakable bond—until ace photographer Vicky enters their lives. As passion and ambition collide, their friendship is put to the ultimate test.

This is a story based on the deep-rooted stance of feudalism in two chosen timelines; 1965 and present-day respectively. The protagonist Ramesh, is a skinny, middle-aged man who works as an office boy at a production house, despite having a mundane and monotonous lifestyle he is very kind, well-spoken, and calm by nature. The stories of Ramdin and Ramesh unravel back and forth and give us a compelling idea about how instilled the concept of feudalism is, in societies new and old.
In a remote village, the seed of hope and freedom is planted in the heart of a girl. Her simple dreams are shattered when a proposal arrives, but not as a promise of love

In this narrative, we follow the journey of a man who didn't treat his wife kindly. His work often invaded their home, and one day, he even invited his secretary over. Unhappy with this, his wife goes missing the next morning, making him realize her true value. Will she return? Tune in to discover the outcome.

A young boy sneaks into a restricted area frequented by couples and men. He climbs the stairs, enters a room, and meets a beautiful girl. She asks him to close the door and confirm his payment. Their ensuing conversation serves as an eye-opener for men who mistreat their wives.

A satirical mockumentary that dives into the wild world of stock markets, where retail traders chase dreams, operators outsmart the game, and finfluencers sell hope (and courses). SHARE BAZAAR: Yahaan Sabhi Gyaani Hain is a sharp, hilarious take on the madness behind the money.
An interrogation between a cop and a criminal turns into a pre-planned crime.
Something like love is the story of Karan and Simran, who have perceived love differently all their lives. Karan's love language is poetry, and for Simran, if love isn't DDLJ, it isn't love.

SAANJH tells the story of Shyam and Sandhya, childhood friends who meet for the last time. Shyam loves Sandhya, but she sees him only as a friend. We surprisingly learn that Shyam is actually struggling with mental disorder, and Sandhya is nothing but just in his imagination. Despite the calm riverbank setting, Shyam's inner struggles are evident. As Shyam faces reality, he realizes he must accept things as they are, showing the power of love and understanding ourselves.
This is the story of a Pandit, Tribhu Pandey. One day while returning from a funeral feast comes across a mysterious skull in the forest with many secrets.

schedules.programName: Once Upon A Time In Office
schedules.description: A young woman is feeling uncomfortable around older male colleagues who are treating her unfairly. She seeks help from HR but does not receive the support she needs. She wonders why she is always the one being blamed and considers ways to address the situation and overcome it

Inspired by true stories, Siraj, a righteous, impoverished flute maker, resides at the edge of the forests of Pilibhit, North India, where man-eating tigers thrive. His mounting livelihood pressures and tragedies corner him to take a drastic measure that threatens to tear down his values and a loved one.

A narrative following a young boy from the Potraj community, who confronts his stepfather, urging him to conform to tradition rather than pursue his aspiration of education and a brighter future. It underscores Shiva's resilience and support system as he strives to fulfill his dreams against all odds.

Set in the 90's when ATM and instant money transfer were still many years far away. In order to withdraw money people had to rely on a lengthy process of MT or Money Transfer which contained a bank to bank secret code.

Aniket an entrepreneur is in his hometown, coming after a very long time. Trying to sell his father's home. After spending few hours in that house he goes back into his childhood memories. Aniket as a young boy was very stubborn. This time he was stuck up on a car. Like his many friends, he also wanted to have a car for his family, instead, his father buys a Scooter. He feels very humiliated and refuses to go by it. The story portrays a basic 90s FatherSon relationship

After 5 years, Nimisha and Atish meet again at a party. She is awarded Best Emerging Entrepreneur by none other than Atish. Atish couldn't let another day go by without confronting Nimisha. Both seem happy and has moved on in their lives until they realize they've been living in a delusion. They reminded each other of their Pact which was made 5 years ago. Live a Little . Then made sudden plans which led to unexpected confessions which led to the most memorable night of their lives.

Mini undergoes an assault, and shortly thereafter, her tormentors meet a grim fate. Stricken with fear and disbelief over these uncanny coincidences, Mini questions the source of these events. Could it be her confidante Bini, or something else entirely?

In a single day, young Pintu skips school, dreams of a better life inspired by a wealthy boy's shoes, and confronts the harsh realities of his underprivileged world, revealing his family's struggles and his own fragile hopes for the future.
The tale of a mother and son trapped in a challenging home situation and how a straightforward life tip helped them escape their predicament.
This is the story of a woman whose captivating beauty lures men into her world, much like a spider weaving an irresistible web
A Married couple meets in a cafe to take divorce but coincidentally their common friend meets them and reminds them of something which might make a shift to their minds.

Ayan and Kabir are small time criminals involved in the kidnapping of a daughter of a dangerous mob boss, Nicole. All they have to do is stick to a kidnapping checklist and check off items as they come to pass. But their novice actions force them to interact with Nicole. Her innocent interactions result in a significantly jacked up ransom amount. Nicole manipulates the situation. Ayan and Kabir struggle to survive as Nicole starts executing her master plan to leave no witnesses behind

A satirical comedy on social media, Party Bhaiya follows a young man from a small village who becomes infatuated with a social media influencer through her videos. Drawn by his growing attraction, he tracks down her location to express his feelings in person. However, this encounter delivers a jarring reality check, revealing the stark differences between her online persona and real life. But in the unpredictable world of social media, surprises await, and Party Bhaiya, his online alias, learns that appearances can be deceiving.

"Chumbak" follows Aryan and Mitisha, once inseparable lovers, who reunite after years. The old flame reignites, but life has diverged their paths. Caught between duty and desire, they must navigate tough choices, testing their love against the changed tides of circumstance. A poignant tale of love's resilience in the face of reality.

In a stormy night, tension unfolds in the affluent household of Akram and Noorie, a middle-aged couple. Abdul, their seventy years old servant and his young petite wife Fatima share the space. Each resident of the household is driven by their dark desires. The morbid darkness of the night hides the truth in that household. Qurbat is a dark psychological thriller involving these two women who draw close for their respective liberation.

The central theme of "Pardesi Love" focuses on a romance involving an Indian taxi driver and a foreign woman who arrives in India from Canada to meet her online boyfriend and fulfill her mother's final rites. However, the situation is far from straightforward. Jasmin intends to wed her boyfriend, Sunny, and establish a life in India, while simultaneously, the cab driver, Satya, develops feelings for her. Yet, the complexities of their relationships and interactions form the crux of the film's narrative, showcasing the dynamic among these three individuals.

A 24-year-old man, struggling with societal pressure to have his first intimate experience, decides to hire a companion. Contrary to his expectations, the encounter is awkward and guilt-ridden, leading to bouts of anxiety. Surprisingly, the woman, mature beyond her years, guides him with ease and grace, helping him realize that what he was searching for couldn't be found in just a few moments of pleasure.

Sita Ram Chaddha's married daughter has the option to seek substantial financial assistance from her affluent brother, but her unique request ends up transforming the lives of everyone involved in unexpected and remarkable ways.

The film explores how society is quick to judge a woman’s success but slow to understand her struggle. Her designer clothes and fancy lifestyle make her the centre of neighbourhood gossip. People label her without knowing that her success comes from sheer determination and a supportive partner. When the truth finally comes out, the community faces the consequences of their prejudice.

Inspired by true stories, Siraj, a righteous, impoverished flute maker, resides at the edge of the forests of Pilibhit, North India, where man-eating tigers thrive. His mounting livelihood pressures and tragedies corner him to take a drastic measure that threatens to tear down his values and a loved one.

A narrative following a young boy from the Potraj community, who confronts his stepfather, urging him to conform to tradition rather than pursue his aspiration of education and a brighter future. It underscores Shiva's resilience and support system as he strives to fulfill his dreams against all odds.

Set in the 90's when ATM and instant money transfer were still many years far away. In order to withdraw money people had to rely on a lengthy process of MT or Money Transfer which contained a bank to bank secret code.

Aniket an entrepreneur is in his hometown, coming after a very long time. Trying to sell his father's home. After spending few hours in that house he goes back into his childhood memories. Aniket as a young boy was very stubborn. This time he was stuck up on a car. Like his many friends, he also wanted to have a car for his family, instead, his father buys a Scooter. He feels very humiliated and refuses to go by it. The story portrays a basic 90s FatherSon relationship

After 5 years, Nimisha and Atish meet again at a party. She is awarded Best Emerging Entrepreneur by none other than Atish. Atish couldn't let another day go by without confronting Nimisha. Both seem happy and has moved on in their lives until they realize they've been living in a delusion. They reminded each other of their Pact which was made 5 years ago. Live a Little . Then made sudden plans which led to unexpected confessions which led to the most memorable night of their lives.

Mini undergoes an assault, and shortly thereafter, her tormentors meet a grim fate. Stricken with fear and disbelief over these uncanny coincidences, Mini questions the source of these events. Could it be her confidante Bini, or something else entirely?

In a single day, young Pintu skips school, dreams of a better life inspired by a wealthy boy's shoes, and confronts the harsh realities of his underprivileged world, revealing his family's struggles and his own fragile hopes for the future.
The tale of a mother and son trapped in a challenging home situation and how a straightforward life tip helped them escape their predicament.
This is the story of a woman whose captivating beauty lures men into her world, much like a spider weaving an irresistible web
A Married couple meets in a cafe to take divorce but coincidentally their common friend meets them and reminds them of something which might make a shift to their minds.

Ayan and Kabir are small time criminals involved in the kidnapping of a daughter of a dangerous mob boss, Nicole. All they have to do is stick to a kidnapping checklist and check off items as they come to pass. But their novice actions force them to interact with Nicole. Her innocent interactions result in a significantly jacked up ransom amount. Nicole manipulates the situation. Ayan and Kabir struggle to survive as Nicole starts executing her master plan to leave no witnesses behind

A satirical comedy on social media, Party Bhaiya follows a young man from a small village who becomes infatuated with a social media influencer through her videos. Drawn by his growing attraction, he tracks down her location to express his feelings in person. However, this encounter delivers a jarring reality check, revealing the stark differences between her online persona and real life. But in the unpredictable world of social media, surprises await, and Party Bhaiya, his online alias, learns that appearances can be deceiving.

"Chumbak" follows Aryan and Mitisha, once inseparable lovers, who reunite after years. The old flame reignites, but life has diverged their paths. Caught between duty and desire, they must navigate tough choices, testing their love against the changed tides of circumstance. A poignant tale of love's resilience in the face of reality.

In a stormy night, tension unfolds in the affluent household of Akram and Noorie, a middle-aged couple. Abdul, their seventy years old servant and his young petite wife Fatima share the space. Each resident of the household is driven by their dark desires. The morbid darkness of the night hides the truth in that household. Qurbat is a dark psychological thriller involving these two women who draw close for their respective liberation.

The central theme of "Pardesi Love" focuses on a romance involving an Indian taxi driver and a foreign woman who arrives in India from Canada to meet her online boyfriend and fulfill her mother's final rites. However, the situation is far from straightforward. Jasmin intends to wed her boyfriend, Sunny, and establish a life in India, while simultaneously, the cab driver, Satya, develops feelings for her. Yet, the complexities of their relationships and interactions form the crux of the film's narrative, showcasing the dynamic among these three individuals.

A 24-year-old man, struggling with societal pressure to have his first intimate experience, decides to hire a companion. Contrary to his expectations, the encounter is awkward and guilt-ridden, leading to bouts of anxiety. Surprisingly, the woman, mature beyond her years, guides him with ease and grace, helping him realize that what he was searching for couldn't be found in just a few moments of pleasure.

Sita Ram Chaddha's married daughter has the option to seek substantial financial assistance from her affluent brother, but her unique request ends up transforming the lives of everyone involved in unexpected and remarkable ways.

The film explores how society is quick to judge a woman’s success but slow to understand her struggle. Her designer clothes and fancy lifestyle make her the centre of neighbourhood gossip. People label her without knowing that her success comes from sheer determination and a supportive partner. When the truth finally comes out, the community faces the consequences of their prejudice.

Raah is an exploration of the several stages of struggle when one steps out to pursue a dream. Sahir lives in Mumbai city with his family. The emotional and poetic narrative explores his faith, kinship and his struggle to establish himself as a poet/writer.
A narrative unfolding the tale of two brothers residing far from their home, eager to dispatch a sweet treat to their unwell father.

When Nidhi visits an orphanage with hopes of adopting, she is confronted by the unresolved trauma of losing her own child to kidnapping. As she battles grief and depression, she must find a way to heal and embrace life again. A poignant tale of loss, resilience, and the power of hope.

This movie serves as an inspirational tool for kids, helping them grasp the extent of their parents' sacrifices and efforts to ensure their lives are comfortable and fulfilling, despite challenging circumstances. It aims to convey a powerful message, encouraging children to maximize their available resources and strive for their best.

The film is about Sara’s journey as she goes about understanding her role in the greater scheme of things. Sara - who has lost her twin sister to a mysterious vanishing - is trying to come to grips with her loss.
A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!
As a devout Hindu seeks vengeance, his two associates with conflicting ideologies attempt to manipulate him.
Notice is a Hindi short film about a couple and the distance which gets created due a loss, it is about the unsaid things in a relationships.

schedules.programName: A Tale Of An Onion Witch  Chapter 2
schedules.description: One year after the mysterious events of part 1, a newly married couple comes across a lady who claims to be Mangla. They are warned about the 150-year-old Witch that wanders around at night asking for an Onion. Things go haywire when a small girl knocks for help at midnight.

Two college time friends embark on a long drive on a Sunday morning, leaving their bustling city lives behind. As they amble through the hilly roads, they reveal to each other, their old longings and hidden pasts. Their rose tinted nostalgia is broken and they come face to face with their imperfect lives.

Haunted by the riots that took his parents 20 years ago, Karan confronts the man who once loved him as a son—yet betrayed him in the worst way. Torn between revenge and forgiveness, he seeks meaning in the madness. A powerful story of loss, betrayal, and the fight for redemption.

Be Khush' is a satire and commentary on commercialism and the society we live in. In a dystopian world, where happiness is scarce and nobody is happy, comes 'Be Khush'. A pill which can provide you happiness on any occasion. But what happens, when someone starts giving away happiness for free?
Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

Ahsaas is the emotional journey of Sana, a devoted wife caught in society’s definition of a “complete woman.” As childlessness becomes a burden, her husband’s support becomes her strength—leading them to seek help and reclaim their peace, together.
A man with a speech disorder who even struggles to do his day to day activities will face his greatest fear of dating a woman.

Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash" delves into the story of a man reluctant to marry his lifelong acquaintance. Shutting himself away and avoiding his father, he faces the girl his father wishes him to wed. When she joins him and locks themselves in a room, they emerge with a revelation connected to the man's inner struggles. Will his father embrace this truth?
Break-ups can be hard, but sometimes they are necessary. Sometimes, you need all your strength to let go and say ... Alvida.

For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

It starts with an after-party sequence. It is late at night. Nimisha, 26, struggles to get a ride back home when Atish, 46, sees this and offers her help. She refuses at first but eventually agrees. The journey gives Nimisha a peek into her boss's life. As they reach Nimisha’s destination they are ready to move on in their lives, but the night has more to offer them. Due to a sudden turn of events, they end up under one roof and despite their differences, they help each other get a new perspective

schedules.programName: A Tale Of An Onion Witch
schedules.description: Two flatmates, evidently from the gym-going North Indian breed of tinsel-town hopefuls, are warned about the 100 year old Witch that occasionally wanders around at night asking for an Onion. When an attractive neighbour knocks for help at midnight, their red-blooded fates unravel.
Jayantika Sengupta: Rani Rahaao: Villain Zoya Sheikh: Child Sundeep Kumar: Son Vikar Tiwari: Friend of a son Sikandar Agarwal: Transgender

A struggling writer decides that he's going to make one last effort to pitch his idea to a film producer. He gets the chance to do so in an unusual way when he turns out to be driving a cab that the producer has hired.

A thief sneaks into a wealthy home for an easy heist—only to find the wife’s secret lover already there! But when the husband arrives, the thief and the lover must hide together, leading to a night of pure chaos, panic, and comedy. Because in this house… "Har chor pe ek mor hota hai!"

Pappu, a misunderstood dreamer, carries a ring for the unknown—waiting for love, waiting for meaning. On a fateful night, he meets Chandini, a mysterious stranger who changes his world in just five hours. As they share stories, laughter, and heartbreak, Pappu finds answers he never knew he needed. But was she ever real? Or just a gift from the sun? A poetic journey of love, loss, and destiny.

A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

In a gripping tale, Finance Minister Supriya Chaudhry leads a crackdown on black money with her secretary, Laxman. After seizing 1200 crores, they discover 600 crores are missing. Laxman uncovers a secret plan, revealing himself as the masked figure holding the bank manager hostage. As chaos ensues and the truth unfolds, Laxman informs Supriya of their covert success, leaving viewers with a tense cliff hanger. The story ends with the title Adarniya Mantri Ji, leaving the mystery unresolved.

A film about a girl moving to Kolkata for her new job. She chooses a hotel for overnight stay where an incident makes her realize that life revolves in a circle and carries her emotionally very close to her home and family.

Manish, a perfect husband and father, tormented by a mysterious parcel he receives from an anonymous sender has to make a life-changing decision. He shares his problems with his cab driver who listens patiently and tries to help. What the cab driver offers changes both of their lives forever.

A Hindi short film revolving around the sad plight of a family who is struggling hard to cope up with everyday expenses. The situation gets so worst that the youngest son robs a chicken from a shop and gets it to the house in spite of them being vegetarians. Watch an emotional journey of this family after the death of patriarchy

23B Raheja is a gripping one-night drama that peels back the glossy layers of the entertainment industry to expose the shadows lurking beneath. The story revolves around a celebrated casting director whose charm masks a long trail of manipulation and exploitation. His power begins to crumble when a young woman arrives at his door, posing as an aspiring actress—but with a haunting connection to his past. As the night unfolds, so does a tense game of revelations, where truth becomes confrontation and justice takes an unexpected form. Taut, timely, and unsettlingly real, 23B Raheja is not just a story of reckoning—it’s a mirror held up to the systems we too often ignore.

Bahaar follows a young woman’s silent suffering inside a marriage built on expectations. Her dreams fade as she’s shamed for infertility—until the family finds a “solution.” A haunting story of societal pressure, dignity, and the myth of the perfect marriage.

Nikhil comes early after work, and his wife runs to the bedroom where a man is hiding under the bed. She tries to indulge in small talks with Nikhil only to distract him so that her boyfriend can run away. What happens at the end is hilarious.

Rinku, a 28-year-old man living with his father, has lost his will to live. However, a wedding in his neighbourhood brings a constant stream of visitors who unknowingly delay his plans and ultimately restore his will to live and succeed.

Late at night, an angry girl had a fight with her boyfriend and called her sister. She had a big suitcase when her sister picked her up in the car. During the drive, they argued and brought up old problems. Things got worse, and the older sister pushed the younger one against the car window in anger. Their argument stopped suddenly when police lights flashed in the dark, and officers pulled them over. The air was tense with anticipation. What would come to light during this unexpected encounter with the police?

Annie, who had recently experienced the loss of her unborn child, crosses paths with an enigmatic homeless man one evening. Unbeknownst to her, that meeting was on the brink of altering her life permanently.

Everyone in the city wants to touch the sky we have to keep running. There is no time to relax, one has to move on or get mowed down. 13th portal talks about a city like that. A city that’s brutal in its ideologies yet accommodates all. The most popular phrase of the people here is, if you come on board we will adjust.

Shreya is a girl who suffers from clinical depression. After escaping a rape attempt, Shreya spirals further into depression and vows to end her life one night. Unknown to Shreya, her suicidal behavior is observed by her neighbor Aryan. The young man races against time to stop Shreya from committing suicide one night. During the night, Shreya and Aryan are drawn close to each other, and end up falling in love. Shreya's depression is finally lifted as she and Aryan embark on a new life together.
A tender story of overlooked friendships and unspoken bonds, where fleeting connections reveal the quiet beauty of everyday life and the people who unknowingly complete us.

title: Swastik Stories

schedules.description: Porus vows to reclaim the Paurav kingdom and punish Shiv Dutt for dishonoring his mother. During the spring festival, disguised women warriors infiltrate the celebrations. Though an explosion was meant to kill him, Porus secretly returns, signaling his survival. Shiv Dutt panics as Puru moves to rescue Queen Anusuya, while Chanakya warns patience over anger. Faking his death, Porus lures Shiv Dutt into overconfidence. Courtesans strike with poisoned veils, decimating his army. Facing Porus and his mother, Shiv Dutt realizes too late that his cruelty has sealed his fate.

Anusuya avenges her family by killing Shiv Dutt, exposing his betrayal and treason, while Puru secretly prepares for coronation to unite India against Alexander at Jhelum. Chaos erupts as Porus is hunted, Kanishk is imprisoned, and the bridge explosion confession surfaces. Chanakya’s intellect clashes with Alexander’s power, who now plots to crush Bharat. At the coronation, King Purushottam performs sacred rituals, turning the ceremony into a battlefield of honor and strategy. Unarmed but resolute, Porus stands ready to defend his motherland and fulfill his deadly vow against Alexander
Swastik TV: Bharat’s soul. Stories, 24/7. Free.
